description: Build a Ready story or bug in a worktree with checkpoint commits per layer, verify each checkpoint, and open a PR.

asked.description: The person's own words asking for this story. An agent needs them to pick up a Ready story that did not come out of grill in this session; without them build stops with a warning before taking the story.

decline.description: Decline open items of the last session review, one "<id>: <why>" a line; the reason goes into the PR's session review summary, and the merge gate's inspect still judges them.

delegate.description: Hand the story to another agent's cloud agent with the delegation brief, or sync it: its PR, inspect's findings, and follow-ups (auto picks the cheapest adequate connected one). OpenCode has no cloud agent, so it always runs locally.

issue.description: Ready story or bug to build; required unless --next.

local.description: With --delegate: run the receiver's CLI on this machine in an aayu worktree, with no GitHub credential; aayu commits, verifies, pushes, and opens the PR.

next.description: The build-ready loop, with no model: ship lists the loop's own open PRs, oldest first, and changes nothing; pick blocks the loop's stale claims, then, under [build] agents, claims the first Ready story or bug (the current release's accepted baseline in its order, else priority, then age) and cuts its worktree.

resume.description: Resume from the last Aayudha-Checkpoint trailer.

stop.description: Stop this build for good: move the story to status:blocked with this reason and page its owner; the lease stays until it expires.

thread.description: With --delegate amp: record the Amp thread (T-…) that the host created for a host hand-off. Build prints a host hand-off in an Amp thread whose amp CLI is not signed in. Only an Amp thread ID is recorded.

title: build
